author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the announcement trailer for Brawlhalla  x DreamWorks Animation’s Shrek crossover event. Ubisoft, in collaboration with Universal Products & Experiences, announced the crossover event launching on July 29. This collaboration brings the films’ unforgettable characters—Shrek, Fiona, and Puss in Boots—from the beloved franchise to  Brawlhalla as playable characters, with Donkey as a Companion. The event will also include a Map featuring Shrek’s iconic Swamp and other items inspired by fairy tale creatures. Additional details on the crossover and those other Items will be shared at a later date. The Brawlhalla  x Shrek crossover event is launching on July 29.
title: Brawlhalla x DreamWorks Animation Shrek - Official Crossover Event Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Take a look at the gameplay trailer for Red Masked Ronin: Desires and Shadows, an open-world RPG game that immerses players in Feudal Japan. You play as a once-honorable samurai who becomes a ronin after being stripped of his rank and expelled from service due to a forbidden scandal. Red Masked Ronin: Desires and Shadows is launching for PC (Steam) on August 6, 2026.
title: Red Masked Ronin: Desires and Shadows - Official Gameplay Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description:
Take a look at the announcement trailer for Stationbreak, a grounded sci-fi station builder developed by 
Broken Spaceship. In Stationbreak, you hold failing systems together while fleeing a relentless, energy-hungry force known as the Swarm. Leading a fleet on the run, you must drop into hostile star systems, gather what resources you can, and jump away before you are overwhelmed. Stationbreak is coming soon to PC (Steam).
title: Stationbreak - Official Announcement Trailer

author: GameTrailers
description: Check out the demo trailer for Breaking Armor, a tank horror game developed by GalaDev. Operate a super-heavy tank alone through the remnants of a ruined world. Discover hidden secrets and face dangers at every turn. Between missions, return to your bunker to refuel, add oxygen, and enhance your tank’s systems. Upgrade your machine to reach further into the unknown. You are protected by 140 tons of steel, but will it be enough? Breaking Armor will be available on PC. A demo is out now on Steam.
title: Breaking Armor - Official Demo Trailer
